reviewer: Independent assistant manually inspected every original/normalized input and raw native output. This is an agent judgment, not human sign-off. Candidate identity was visible; review was independent but not blinded.
scope: 24-case native screen only. No inferred Core acceptance, dictionary restoration/fallback or whole-app result. Exact literal-marker/payload retention is required in these cases.

definitions.faithful: Preserves intended meaning, speech act/tone/uncertainty/emphasis/quoted words and exact protected bytes. Literal-contract failure also fails this judgment.
definitions.useful: A faithful edit improves a material cleanup defect; partial edits may count, but a destructive literal candidate receives no useful credit.
definitions.fully_cleaned: Output is faithful, directly usable and every identified cleanup defect is resolved. No-edit inputs count true when preserved adequately.
definitions.acceptable: Faithful and fully clean plain text. Faithful partial cleanup or worsening clean punctuation is not acceptable.
definitions.needs_cleanup: Original fixture human-authored need, not a model-derived judgment. Read normalized input alongside it; numeric normalization alone earns no model credit.
definitions.severity: Critical: changed/lost substantive value/action or invented content; major: lost tone/quotation or exact literal contract; minor: missed cleanup/grammatical/presentation issue; none: no defect.
